basic_profile.bio: I've been gaming since I was a kid, and Destiny 2 has been my main escape. I work as a tech support specialist in Dayton, Ohio, which keeps me on my toes. I usually browse Reddit late at night after work or during lunch breaks. Not a big fan of early mornings! I'm single, focusing on my career and gaming at the moment.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in tech troubleshooting, thanks to years of working in tech support. I also learned a lot about Destiny 2 and other video games through countless hours of gameplay and online guides. I tend to pick up new tech skills quickly, often through self-teaching and community forums.
